notes.title: 3.1 Release
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42621975/3ddb3fe235ed7f23c5141e86ceb5c6d6e5094788.png"][/img][/p][p]Small QoL update to make configuring the game easier.[/p][list][*][p]The settings menu is now cleaner[/p][/*][*][p]Added an extremely distracting rainbow theme[/p][/*][*][p]Added resolution settings[/p][list][*][p]Previously, the game always rendered at full resolution and downscaled from there according to your window size. There are now proper resolution settings.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual glitch relating to the Frog.[/p][/*][/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42621975/ebf7bf7f9afad3b11bef91494000ff6086a9b7fd.png[/img]

- Added a new piece, the Maxman (Available from the start)
- Removed Discord (Discord pieces are now available for everyone without needing to join)
- Replaced the main menu music ([b]haha[/b])
- The main menu is also now "choppier"
- Added a new black & white theme
- Bunch of bug fixes that I did not write down
